title: Fleet Service Spend Credit — Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
# Fleet Service Spend Credit

On a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, the fleet service spend credit adds up the customer's service spend over the past year. The spend is the labor and parts amounts charged with pay type customer pay on the customer's repair orders whose line date is fewer than 12 whole months before the pricing date, the day the addendum is signed. Lines are read from the customer's Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

- Amounts are taken as charged and before any credit.
- Deductible lines owed on covered work (service contract or warranty deductibles) are not counted.
- Diagnostic fees, shop fees, payments and late fees are not labor or parts charges and are not added.

| Customer-pay labor and parts in the window | Fleet service spend credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 40.00 |
| 500.00 or more, but less than 5000.00 | 20.00 |
| Less than 500.00 | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical totals)
| Total | Credit |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 | 40.00 |
| 4999.99 | 20.00 |
| 500.00 | 20.00 |
| 499.99 | none |

Hypothetical illustration: labor of 380.00 and parts of 145.50, both customer pay and inside the window, total 525.50. A credit later posted on the same lines does not reduce this total, so it earns 20.00.
